Indian States Aim for 1.18 Million Jobs via New GCCs by 2031

Indian states are projected to create 1.18 million jobs and establish over 1,300 new Global Capability Centers (GCCs) by 2031. This initiative is part of India's strategy to foster multi-city growth. The targets are set by state governments to drive economic expansion and employment opportunities through these centers.
